question:
1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 are written on different faces of a dice. Three different positions of the same dice are shown below. Find the number on the face opposite to the one showing '3'?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f1575da8671c4a0495349b243408308ff653285b064ce48a8e3b78c6f4960e0.png]
solution:
From the dice 2 and 3:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c792f25c4042686a9c6467ba1a29779824255ac58162b23caa267a1e7a31df46.png]
